description: Ministry of Internal & Home Affairs - Altered by inclusion of the reclaimed area of land known as "Port City Colombo" within the area of Authority and Limits of the Administrative District of Colombo
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land matters, specifically the inclusion of the reclaimed "Port City Colombo" land area into the Colombo Administrative District. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, boundaries, coordinates, and extents, making it fundamentally about land registration and administrative boundaries rather than government personnel changes or structural reforms.
